What Gets Delivered

What Counts as Alcohol Delivery from Liquor & Wine Outlet?

Liquor & Wine Outlet's Murfreesboro alcohol delivery covers three main categories, all packaged and shipped via DoorDash or Uber Eats. Here's what you can (and can't) order.

🍷 Wine

Red, white, rosé, sparkling wines, and Champagne — single bottles, gift sets, and small quantities for events. Larger volumes for weddings coordinate through the store directly.

🍺 Beer

Craft beer, local Tennessee breweries, imports — six-packs, twelve-packs, and cases where allowed by platform rules. Kegs require in-store pickup and coordination.

🥃 Spirits

Whiskey, bourbon, scotch, vodka, rum, tequila, gin, and liqueurs. Rare and allocated bottles may be in-store pickup only — call to confirm before ordering.

Bottle sizes and quantity limits are set by DoorDash and Uber Eats platform policies. Check your cart for restrictions before checkout.

TN ABC Compliance

Tennessee Alcohol Delivery Rules You Should Know

Alcohol delivery in Murfreesboro follows Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission rules. A quick summary before your first order.

🪪

21+ ID at the Door

The recipient must be 21 or older and present an unexpired, government-issued photo ID. The driver scans or visually verifies before handing over.

🕐

Store-Hours Windows

Alcohol deliveries only complete during retailer hours. For Liquor & Wine Outlet: Mon–Sat 8 AM to 11 PM and Sun 10 AM to 11 PM.

🚫

No Delivery to Intoxicated Persons

Drivers are trained to refuse delivery if the recipient appears intoxicated. The order is returned; refund policy follows the platform.

🏠

Residential Addresses Only

Alcohol delivery is generally limited to residential addresses. Deliveries to bars, restaurants, hotels, or open public spaces are not permitted under TN retail-delivery rules.

Full rules are published by the Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission. This summary reflects retailer practice — always defer to current TN ABC regulations.

Timing

How Long Does Murfreesboro Alcohol Delivery Take?

Most Murfreesboro alcohol orders complete in 30 to 60 minutes. Here's how that time breaks down.

1

Order Confirmed (0–3 min)

Payment authorizes and the order routes to the Liquor & Wine Outlet register at 2003 SE Broad Street.

2

Store Prep (5–15 min)

Staff pulls the bottles, packs them securely, tags for the delivery driver. Faster on weekday afternoons, slower on Friday and Saturday evenings.

3

Driver Dispatch (0–10 min)

DoorDash or Uber Eats assigns a nearby driver. Wait time depends on driver availability in the Murfreesboro area at that moment.

4

Drive Time (10–35 min)

Depends on your address. Central Murfreesboro: 10–20 min. Smyrna or La Vergne: 20–35 min. Christiana or Rockvale: up to 40 min at peak.

5

ID Check & Handoff (1–2 min)

Driver verifies ID at the door. Recipient must be 21+, appear sober, and sign or scan. Order handed over — done.

Typical total: 30–60 minutes. Peak Friday and Saturday nights can extend to 75 minutes.

DoorDash and Uber Eats drivers accept unexpired, government-issued photo IDs: a Tennessee (or any US state) driver's license, a US passport, a US passport card, a US military ID, or a Tennessee state ID card. By Tennessee law and platform policy, the driver cannot leave alcohol unattended. If no adult 21 or older is available to show ID and sign, the order will be returned to Liquor & Wine Outlet. A restocking fee typically applies, and the customer may not be fully refunded. Make sure someone 21+ can meet the driver at the delivery address.
